tutorials.title: Multiworld Setup Guide
tutorials.description: A guide to setting up Zuma Deluxe for MultiWorld.
tutorials.text:
# Zuma Deluxe MultiWorld Setup Guide

## Required Software

- Zuma Deluxe from [Steam](https://store.steampowered.com/app/3330/Zuma_Deluxe/) in English
  - The pointers may not work with other version from other places
  - Will not work with other languages
- [Archipelago](https://github.com/ArchipelagoMW/Archipelago/releases/latest)
- [The Zuma Deluxe apworld](https://github.com/Movido51/Archipelago/releases)

## Optional Software

- [Universal Tracker](https://github.com/FarisTheAncient/Archipelago/releases?q=Tracker), to help see available locations

## Before Playing

You need a file that has unlock whatever sections you want to play.
If you start from a empty one, playing the first 3 temples of adventure will unlock you relatively easy 15 boards on gauntlet mode, there is a preset for those levels. (1-5, 8-12, 15-20) 

## How to play

First, you need a room to connect to. For this, you or someone you know has to generate a game.  
This will not be explained here,
but you can check the [Archipelago Setup Guide](/tutorial/Archipelago/setup_en#generating-a-game).

You also need to have [Archipelago](https://github.com/ArchipelagoMW/Archipelago/releases/latest) installed
and the [The Zuma Deluxe apworld](https://github.com/Movido51/Archipelago/releases) installed into Archipelago. This will make the client be listed in Archipelago.

From here, to connect you need to open the **Zuma Deluxe Client** either from the Archipelago Launcher or if the room comes from a Webhost you can enter by clicking your name.

Once the **Zuma Deluxe Client** is open and connected it will search for the **Zuma Deluxe** game, once its open you can go to the Zuma Deluxe Tab and play.

notes.text:
A somewhat playable version of the randomizer for Zuma Deluxe, still changes to come.

Only a client fix from the version 0.1.6.

# Quick Fixes
- goal for space and goal locations are sended now.

# Compatible Version
This release is a client fix of version [0.1.0](https://github.com/Movido51/Archipelago/releases/tag/zuma-deluxe-v0.1.6-b) its compatible with the games made in that version, and only affects the client.

Remainders
- You need to have the Zuma Deluxe Client and the Zuma Deluxe game open at the same time to play, if you dont have the game open the client will not receive items.

- If you connect while you have a level open in Zuma go back to the menu.

- If the game is not found it probably is not being played on English.

- To keep track of locations you can use universal tracker

Any question, Bug or idea, feel free to ask on the discord channel for the game.
